content: बन्धुः [बध्नाति मनः स्नेहादिना बन्ध्-उ] .²1 A relation, kinsman, relative in general; यत्र द्रुमा अपि मृगा अपि बन्धवो मे <ls>U. 3. 8</ls>; मातृबन्धुनिवासिनम् <ls>R. 12. 12</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 23</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 9</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 136</ls>. .²2 Any one connected or associated with another, a brother; प्रवासबन्धुः a brother-traveller; धर्मबन्धुः a spiritual brother; अनुमतगमना शकुन्तला तरुभिरियं वनवासबन्धुभिः <ls>Ś. 4. 10</ls>. .²3 (In law) A cognate kinsman, oneʼs own kindred or kinsmen generally; (three kinds are enumerated:-- आत्म˚ personal, पितृ˚ paternal, and मातृ˚ maternal; see these three words). .²4 A friend (in general); as in बन्धुकृत्य below; <ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>; मकरन्दगन्धबन्धो <ls>Māl. 1. 38</ls> ‘a friend of, ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%}) charged with fragrance’ <ab>&c.</ab>, <ls n="Māl.">9. 13</ls>. .²5 A husband; वैदेहिबन्धोर्हृदयं विदद्रे <ls>R. 14. 33</ls>. .²6 A father. .²7 A mother. .²8 A brother. .²9 The tree called बन्धुजीव <ab>q. v.</ab> .²10 One who belongs to or is connected with any tribe or profession only nominally; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} one who belongs to it, but does not do the duties pertaining thereto (often used by way of contempt); स्वयमेव ब्रह्मबन्धुनोद्भिन्नो दुर्गप्रयोगः <ls>M. 4</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> क्षत्रबन्धु. .²11 Connection, relationship, association in general; समुद्र एवास्य बन्धुः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 1. 2</ls>; <ls>B. R. 3. 89</ls>. .²12 A controller, governor; (नमः) गुणत्रयाभासनिमित्तबन्धवे <ls>Bhāg. 6. 4. 23</ls>. .²13 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the 3rd mansion.
